description: Returns the AEMET forecast for any of Spain's 8000+ municipalities. Accepts a name (with or without accents) or INE code. Daily granularity returns temperature min/max, sky state, precipitation probability and wind for each day. Hourly returns the next ~40h.

days.description: Daily forecasts: number of days to include (1-7, default 3). Ignored when granularity='hourly'.

granularity.description: 'daily' (default) summarises up to 7 days. 'hourly' returns hour-by-hour values for the next ~40 hours.

location.description: Spanish municipality, either by name (e.g. 'Madrid', 'Logroño', 'A Coruña') or by 5-digit INE code (e.g. '28079').

name: get_forecast
title: Weather forecast for a Spanish municipality
